title.narrative: Worldwide Governance Index Rule of Law score

description.narrative: Worldwide Governance Index Rule of Law score

comment.narrative: Numerical representation of a specific countrys overall adherence to the principles of the rule of law on a scale from 0 to 1 and its relative position compared to other countries in a given year annual. The Index assesses a total of 140 countries in 8 main dimensions constraint on government powers corruption open government fundamental rights order and security regulatory enforcement civil justice and criminal justice. Subregional and global values should be weighted by population. The score rates countries between those that have low level of adherence to the principles of the rule of law closer to 0 to those that have a high level of adherence closer to 1.The regional score in the Rule of Law is calculated by multiplying the scores of all the countries covered by CT JUST by the size of their population adding these totals and then dividing them by the total population of all the countries covered. The countries covered include Morocco Algeria Tunisia Libya Egypt Iraq Jordan Lebanon Mauritania Sudan Somalia Mali Burkina Faso Niger Nigeria Chad Ivory Coast Eritrea Ethiopia South Sudan Kenya.Values for each reporting period will not be cumulatively summed. Instead the most recently reported value as of the latest annual reporting period will be considered the current value.
The final target value is regional and represents a 5 improvement of the baseline value

title.narrative: Global Peace Index

description.narrative: Used to measure the relative position of nations and regions peacefulness

comment.narrative: Numerical representation of a specific countrys overall level of peace and stability 1 very high 2 high 3 medium 4 low 5 very low and its relative position compared to other countries in a given year annual. The Index assesses a total of 163 countries on 23 qualitative and quantitative indicators. The analysis developed is structured around 3 dimensions societal safety and security the extent of ongoing domestic and international conflict and the degree of militarization.The regional score in the Global Peace Index is calculated by multiplying the scores of all the countries covered by CT JUST by the size of their population adding these totals and then dividing them by the total population of all the countries covered. The countries covered include Morocco Algeria Tunisia Libya Egypt Iraq Jordan Lebanon Mauritania Sudan Somalia Mali Burkina Faso Niger Nigeria Chad Ivory Coast Eritrea Ethiopia South Sudan Kenya.Values for each reporting period will not be cumulatively summed. Instead the most recently reported value as of the latest annual reporting period will be considered the current value.
The final target value is regional and represents a 5 improvement of the baseline value

title.narrative: Global Terrorism Index

description.narrative: Numerical representation of the impact of terrorism in a specific country (10 very high, 8 high, 6 medium, 4 low, 2 very low, 0 no impact) and its relative position compared to other countries in a given year (annual). The Index assesses a total of 163 countries in 10 main dimensions: incidents, fatalities, injuries, property damage, terrorist groups, attack methods, geographic spread, financing, counterterrorism measures, and underlying political and social factors. Subregional and global values should be weighted by population.The regional score in the Global Terrorism Index is calculated by multiplying the scores of all the countries covered by CT JUST by the size of their population, adding these totals, and then dividing them by the total population of all the countries covered. The countries covered include Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Libya, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon, Mauritania, Sudan, Somalia, Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger, Nigeria, Chad, Ivory Coast, Eritrea, Ethiopia, South Sudan, Kenya.Values for each reporting period will not be cumulatively summed. Instead, the most recently reported value, as of the latest annual reporting period, will be considered the current value.

comment.narrative: The final target value is regional and represents a 5 improvement of the baseline value
